issue_context.title: Sidekiq::Stats::History.cleanup keys * is slow and kills our servers
issue_context.body:
@mperham 

If you have say 8.167.491 keys in your redis then keys with \* get's pretty slow and when 30 or so worker do it at the same time redis is not happy :D

I'd like to make a pull to either:
- only do it once every 10 days (via a redis key like last_cleaned_up_at)
- use expire on the processed / failed so it is not necessary

would you merge any of these / what would you prefer ?
comments:
I thought that the prefix would make the key enum quick but I guess redis doesn't index the keys.

Either a 180 day TTL or rewrite the pruning to not use keys would be fine.  I'd prefer the TTL just because all data in Redis should have a TTL to prevent ever-growing data.

review_comments:
Why this logic?  Why not just blindly set the expire in multi?  That would save a round trip.
I was thinking rather 1 roundtrip a day then 1 extra command per job, but either way is fine, do you want it changed ?
Oh got it, you're right.
